About

I am an electrical and electronics engineering graduate of Tokat Gaziosmanpaşa University (GPA 3.30/4.00), based in Istanbul and open to roles in Turkey and the Gulf. I work across power systems, industrial automation and embedded control, with field experience in high-voltage equipment at Chad's national electricity company. I communicate in Arabic, French, Turkish and English.
